senses.gloss: (v. חִגֵּר) to halt, to limp; to hesitate.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 18a:1">Ḥull. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שתַּחְגּוֹר וכ׳</he> a notch deep enough for the nail to halt on passing over the edge; <cite ref="Bekhorot 37b">Bekh. 37ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 4:1">Tosef. ib. IV, 1</cite> <he>והיא חוֹגֶרֶת</he> and it (the finger nail) is caught.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="H00157">same</cite>. Y. Pes. VII, 35ᵇ top <he>כדי שתהא היד מַחְגֶּרֶת</he> enough for the finger to be caught.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 3:1">Zab. III, 1</cite> <he>מַחְגִּירִין</he> they halt (do not stand firm).
